envelope.description: Resume only unfinished work through both reviewer routes

body.title: Resume only unfinished work through both reviewer routes
body.summary: Integrate validated explicit recovery into the current coordinator, actual controller exchange and opt-in task-review RPC. Retain saved terminal task results, rebind actual controller connections, and repair pending publication without repeating review work.
acceptanceChecks: Explicit latest-attempt resume with an empty active map restores pinned input/order and schedules only selected tasks with no terminal result. Passed, changes_requested, incomplete and failed results all remain unchanged and are never retried in that attempt.

Daemon continuation acknowledges promptly and outlives the submitting connection. Controller continuation binds a new trusted current owner, rejects foreign/old owners, stops on disconnect and retains completed work.

Acknowledgements, controller frames and polled checkpoint agree on reviewId, actual attempt, reviewer, derived path, status and preserved/completed task IDs for attempt1 recovery, later attempts and terminal replay.

Each new terminal result is atomically saved before the next task. Existing S/M/L allowance and conservative failure classification remain; unfinished work may restart on explicit resume, but terminal outcomes require a later attempt.

All-terminal publication-pending recovery invokes no provider and replays canonical CR publication idempotently. A published terminal resume returns existing completion metadata; source/persistence/publication failures remain explicit and preserve feedback.
Only the existing explicit task-review route is extended; full normal MCP/session-thread migration and Story-approval cleanup remain S3.

tests.name: interrupted recovery: only absent tasks rerun and terminal failed/incomplete tasks are skipped
controller recovery: new trusted connection, old-owner refusal, disconnect retention and daemon lifetime distinction
publication recovery: saved feedback projects once with zero provider calls and conflict-free replay
retrigger metadata: resume and sequential attempts return the pinned attempt/status and preserved task IDs
